home.title: Welcome to Postloom
home.intro: Send beautiful, personal emails to a list of people - from your own email account, with checks before anything is sent.
home.stepConnectHint: Postloom sends from your own email address, so replies come straight back to you.
home.stepConnectFix: {{name}} needs you. Open Senders & accounts to fix it.
home.stepTemplateHint: Pick a starting point and change the words to your own. Most people take about 5 minutes.
home.stepSendHint: We'll walk you through it, and check everything with you first.
home.tipNothingSent: Nothing is ever sent until you say so, and you can always send a test to yourself first.
home.tipLocal: Your lists and emails stay on this computer.

placeholder.body: This part of Postloom is being built. It will be ready in a later version.

templates.title: Templates
templates.intro: Reusable emails you can send again and again.
templates.nameHint: Something you'll recognise, like “Payment reminder”. Leave empty to use the starter's name.
templates.emptyBody: A template is an email you can reuse. Make one and Postloom fills in each person's details for you.
templates.subject: Subject
templates.usesFields: Details it uses from your list
templates.galleryHint: Pick a starting point. You'll change the words to your own next.

plainLetter.name: Plain letter
plainLetter.description: A simple personal letter. Start here if you are not sure.

paymentReminder.name: Payment reminder
paymentReminder.description: A friendly nudge about an invoice that is due.

invoice.name: Invoice
invoice.description: Send an invoice with the amount and due date.

thankYou.name: Thank you
thankYou.description: Say thank you after a purchase, visit or favour.

welcome.name: Welcome
welcome.description: Welcome a new customer, member or colleague.

announcement.name: Announcement
announcement.description: Share news: a new service, new hours or a change.

newsletter.name: Newsletter
newsletter.description: A short update with a few stories.

eventInvite.name: Event invite
eventInvite.description: Invite people to an event and ask them to reply.

templates.imported: “{{name}}” imported. Check it over before sending.
templates.importedPictures: {{count}} picture from the file wasn't brought in. Add it again with Picture.
templates.importedPictures_other: {{count}} pictures from the file weren't brought in. Add them again with Picture.
templates.importedTextOnly: The layout couldn't be kept, so only the words were imported.

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.validationFailed: Some information is missing or not valid.
errors.templateInvalid: This template couldn't be read. Check it for typing mistakes.
errors.emailAuthFailed: Your email provider didn't accept the password. Many providers, like Gmail, need an "app password" for apps like Postloom.
errors.passwordMissing: There's no saved password for this email account. Add it in Senders & accounts.
errors.passwordUnreadable: Postloom can't read the saved password on this computer (it may have been copied from another computer). Enter the password again in Senders & accounts.
errors.secretsUnavailable: This computer can't store passwords safely right now, so the password wasn't saved.
errors.emailConnectionFailed: Postloom couldn't reach your email provider. Check your internet connection and the server details.
errors.emailSendFailed: The email couldn't be sent. Please try again later.
errors.headerLineBreak: A subject, name or email address contains a line break. Remove it and try again.
errors.imageTooBig: That picture file is too big (over 20 MB). Choose a smaller one.
errors.imageType: Postloom can use PNG and JPEG pictures. Choose a .png or .jpg file.
errors.imageUnreadable: That picture couldn't be opened. It may be damaged. Try another one.
errors.imageMissing: A picture in this template is missing. Remove it and add it again.
errors.htmlTooBig: That file is too big to be an email (over 2 MB).
errors.spreadsheetTooBig: That spreadsheet is too big (over 25 MB). Save just the sheet you need as a new file, then try again.
errors.spreadsheetType: Postloom can read Excel (.xlsx) and CSV files. In Excel, use File → Save As and choose "Excel Workbook (.xlsx)".
errors.spreadsheetUnreadable: That spreadsheet couldn't be opened. It may be damaged or password-protected. Save it again in Excel and try once more.
errors.spreadsheetTooManyRows: That list has more than 20,000 rows. Split it into smaller lists and send them one at a time.
errors.spreadsheetEmpty: That spreadsheet has no rows to read. Check you picked the right file.
errors.listGone: Postloom lost track of that list (it only keeps a few open at a time). Choose the file again.
errors.rowNotFound: That row isn't in the list any more. Choose the file again.
errors.notFound: We couldn't find that. It may have been deleted.
errors.inUse: This is still being used, so it can't be removed yet.
errors.databaseDamaged: Postloom couldn't read its saved information.
errors.databaseUpgradeFailed: Postloom couldn't update its saved information. Nothing was lost, and a backup was kept.
errors.screenTitle: Something went wrong on this screen
errors.screenBody: Your saved work is safe. Try again, and if it keeps happening, use Help → Export diagnostics.
errors.sendHasProblems: Something on the Check step must be fixed before sending. Go back and fix it, then try again.
errors.sendNobody: Nobody on this list will get an email. Put some rows back or choose another list.
errors.sendAccountBusy: This email account is already sending. Wait for that send to finish (or pause it), then try again.

settings.intro: Make Postloom look and behave the way you like.
settings.confirmBeforeSendHint: Shows a summary of who gets what, with 10 seconds to change your mind.

gmail.label: Gmail
gmail.appPasswordHelp: Gmail needs an app password, not your normal password. In your Google Account open Security → 2-Step Verification → App passwords, create one called “Postloom” and paste the 16 letters here.

outlook.label: Outlook
outlook.appPasswordHelp: Outlook needs an app password. Sign in to your Microsoft account, open Security → Advanced security options → App passwords, create one and paste it here.

yahoo.label: Yahoo Mail
yahoo.appPasswordHelp: Yahoo needs an app password. Open Account Info → Account Security → Generate app password, choose “Other app”, name it Postloom and paste it here.

zoho.label: Zoho Mail
zoho.appPasswordHelp: Zoho needs an application-specific password. Open My Account → Security → App Passwords, generate one for Postloom and paste it here.

icloud.label: iCloud Mail
icloud.appPasswordHelp: iCloud needs an app-specific password. Sign in at account.apple.com, open Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords, create one and paste it here.

accounts.appPasswordNextBody: {{provider}} asks apps like Postloom to use a separate password instead of your normal one. We'll show you where to find it. It takes about two minutes.
accounts.otherNextBody: Your IT person or email provider can tell you the server name. Postloom only connects over an encrypted connection.
accounts.addressHint: The address people will see your emails come from.
accounts.addressInvalid: This doesn't look like an email address. Check it for typing mistakes.
accounts.passwordHint: The password for this email account.
accounts.nameHint: Only you see it, e.g. “Office Gmail”.
accounts.usernameHint: Leave empty if it's the same as your email address.
accounts.protectionKeychain: Your password is locked away in this computer's own secure keychain, never in a file. It never leaves this computer.
accounts.protectionWeak: This computer has no password keyring, so the saved password is only lightly protected. It's safer to install and unlock a keyring (such as GNOME Keyring or KWallet) before continuing.
accounts.protectionUnavailable: This computer can't store passwords safely right now, so Postloom can't save an email account. Restart your computer and try again.
accounts.testSent: Test email sent to {{address}}. Check your inbox.
accounts.removeBlocked: Used by {{count}} sender. Move or remove it first.
accounts.removeBlocked_other: Used by {{count}} senders. Move or remove them first.
accounts.fixBody: It usually means the password was changed or the app password was removed. Nothing is sent from this account until it's fixed.
accounts.fixMissingBody: Enter the password so Postloom can send from this account.

senders.title: Senders & accounts
senders.intro: An email account does the sending. A sender is who your emails appear to come from.
senders.emptyBody: A sender is the name and address people see. Connect your email first, then add a sender.
senders.noAccountsBody: Postloom sends from your own email account. Connect it and you'll be ready in a few minutes.
senders.fromNameHint: Shown as who the email is from, e.g. “Asha Kapoor”.
senders.fromNameMissing: Enter the name people will see.
senders.fromAddressHint: Usually the same as the email account's address. Some providers reject other addresses.
senders.replyToHint: Leave empty to get replies at the address above.
senders.deleteBlocked: Used by {{count}} template. Choose another sender for it first.
senders.deleteBlocked_other: Used by {{count}} templates. Choose another sender for them first.
senders.brandHint: The logo, colour and font used in emails from this sender.
senders.fontHint: Fonts that look the same in almost every email app.

setup.title: Set up Postloom
setup.privacy: Everything stays on this computer. Your password is locked away in your computer's own secure keychain, never in a file.
setup.welcomeBody: In a few minutes you'll connect your email, tell Postloom who you are, and send yourself a test. You can change everything later.
setup.providerBody: Postloom sends from your own email address, so replies come straight back to you.
setup.chooseFirst: Choose your email provider to continue.
setup.senderBody: This is the name people see in their inbox. You can add more senders later, for example one for each team.
setup.testBody: We'll send a short email to {{address}} so you can see it arrive.
setup.testSentBody: It can take a minute to arrive. If you can't see it, look in your spam folder.
setup.doneBody: {{account}} is connected, and your emails will come from {{sender}}.

status.error: Couldn't save. Retrying when you make a change.
status.invalid: Something in this letter can't be saved. Undo your last change.

editor.previewHint: Personal details show as [First Name]. They're filled in for each person when you send.
editor.testSent: Test sent to {{address}}. Check your inbox.
editor.subjectHint: {{count}} of about {{limit}} characters that most inboxes show. Details count as their name.
editor.detailsHint: Details are the columns in your spreadsheet. You'll match them when you send.

linkModal.title: Add a link
linkModal.label: Web or email address
linkModal.invalid: Use a full address starting with https:// or mailto:

buttonModal.title: Add a button
buttonModal.label: Button text
buttonModal.labelMissing: Enter the words on the button.

detailModal.title: Add a detail
detailModal.name: Column name in your list
detailModal.nameHint: Exactly as it's written in your spreadsheet, e.g. First Name.
detailModal.nameInvalid: Use letters, numbers and spaces (no quotes, braces, % or < >).
detailModal.fallbackHint: Optional, e.g. “there” so it reads “Dear there”.

editor.fromHint: Who this template usually comes from. You can change it when you send.
editor.noSenders: Add a sender in Senders & accounts to send tests.
editor.designTitle: Need columns, a table or a newsletter layout?
editor.designBody: Design mode lets you arrange blocks, add tables and show parts only to some people. Your words stay as they are.
editor.historyHint: Postloom keeps your last 50 saved versions.
editor.keepVersion: Keep a copy of this version

pictureModal.title: Add a picture
pictureModal.altHint: Read out to people who can't see pictures, and shown if the picture doesn't load, e.g. “Our new shop front”.
pictureModal.altMissing: Describe the picture in a few words.
pictureModal.inside: The picture travels inside each email, so it shows even if you don't have a website.

editor.writeBlocked: This template uses Design blocks (columns, tables, spacers, footers or show-only-if parts). Remove them to go back to Write mode.
editor.designHelpBody: Use “Add block” for columns, tables, spacers, a footer, and parts shown only to some people. On phones, columns stack one under the other.

rule.title: Show this part only to some people
rule.fieldHint: A column in your list, e.g. Discount.
rule.valueHint: Upper and lower case don't matter.
rule.valueMissing: Enter the value to compare with.

examples.title: Try with example details
examples.hint: Type example details to see how one person's email will look, including the parts shown only to some people.
examples.none: This template doesn't use any details yet.
examples.showing: Showing the email one person with these details would get.
examples.subject: Subject: {{subject}}

checks.subjectMissing: Add a subject so people know what the email is about.
checks.subjectLong: The subject is {{count}} characters. Most inboxes cut it off after about {{limit}}.
checks.letterEmpty: The email is empty. Write your message first.
checks.linkInvalid: The link on “{{text}}” doesn't go anywhere. Use a full address starting with https://.
checks.buttonLinkInvalid: The “{{label}}” button doesn't go anywhere yet. Add a full web address.
checks.buttonLinkExample: The “{{label}}” button still points to the example address. Change it to your own link.
checks.tooLarge: This email is {{size}} KB. Gmail hides the end of emails over about 102 KB.
checks.imageAltMissing: {{count}} picture needs a description for people who can't see pictures.
checks.imageAltMissing_other: {{count}} pictures need a description for people who can't see pictures.
checks.imagesHeavy: Pictures add {{size}} KB to every email. Smaller pictures send faster and are less likely to look like spam.

send.title: Send emails
send.intro: Send a template to everyone on a list, with checks before anything goes out.

list.emptyBody: Use an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file with one person per row and a column of email addresses.
list.columnsTitle: Which columns hold the email addresses?
list.toHint: Several addresses in one cell can be separated with ; or ,
list.enabled: Send only if this column says yes
list.enabledHint: Rows that say no, false, 0 or x are left out.
list.chooseTo: Choose the column with the email addresses to continue.
list.sampleTitle: The first rows of your list
list.attachmentsHint: File paths, several separated by ; (paths can start from the list's folder).

template.noTemplates: You don't have a template yet.
template.senderHint: Only for this send. The template keeps its usual sender.
template.noSenders: Add a sender before you send.
template.subject: Subject
template.detailsTitle: Where each personal detail comes from
template.detailsBody: Match each detail in the template to a column in your list.
template.noDetails: This template doesn't use any personal details, so everyone gets the same email.

check.putBack: Put back the rows I left out
check.sendDuplicatesOnce: Send only once to each address

problems.missingColumn: “{{field}}” isn't matched to a column in your list.
problems.missingColumnFallback: “{{field}}” isn't matched to a column, so everyone gets its “if empty” text.
problems.invalidAddress: {{count}} row has an email address that isn't valid.
problems.invalidAddress_other: {{count}} rows have an email address that isn't valid.
problems.overDailyLimit: This is {{count}} emails, but this account can send only {{remaining}} more today.
problems.emptyDetail: “{{field}}” is empty for {{count}} person, so a gap will appear in their email.
problems.emptyDetail_other: “{{field}}” is empty for {{count}} people, so a gap will appear in their emails.
problems.duplicate: {{count}} row repeats an address from an earlier row.
problems.duplicate_other: {{count}} rows repeat an address from earlier rows.
problems.doNotEmail: {{count}} person is on your “Do not email” list and will be left out.
problems.doNotEmail_other: {{count}} people are on your “Do not email” list and will be left out.
problems.disabled: {{count}} row isn't marked to send and will be left out.
problems.disabled_other: {{count}} rows aren't marked to send and will be left out.
problems.largeSend: Sending {{count}} emails will take a while. You can keep using your computer.
problems.attachmentMissing: {{count}} row names a file to attach that can't be found.
problems.attachmentMissing_other: {{count}} rows name files to attach that can't be found.
problems.attachmentBlocked: {{count}} row tries to attach a private file (a key or password file). Postloom never sends those.
problems.attachmentBlocked_other: {{count}} rows try to attach private files (keys or password files). Postloom never sends those.
problems.attachmentTooBig: {{count}} row has more than {{limit}} MB of attachments, too much for one email.
problems.attachmentTooBig_other: {{count}} rows have more than {{limit}} MB of attachments, too much for one email.
problems.attachmentOutside: Some files come from a folder you haven't used before: {{folder}}
problems.attachmentOutside_other: Some files come from folders you haven't used before, like {{folder}}

check.overLimitHelp: Leave out the rows over the limit and send them tomorrow, or raise the account's daily limit in Senders & accounts.
check.nobody: Nobody on this list will get an email. Put some rows back or choose another list.
check.sendTest: Send this person's email to me
check.testSent: Test sent to {{address}}, with the details from row {{row}}. Check your inbox.
check.testFirst: Send yourself a test first, to see exactly what people will get.
check.trustFolders: These are fine, trust these folders

confirm.title: Ready to send
confirm.time: About {{minutes}} minute, with a pause between emails so your provider stays happy.
confirm.time_other: About {{minutes}} minutes, with a pause between emails so your provider stays happy.
confirm.notSaved: Once you press Send now, emails start going out. You can pause or stop at any time.

progress.subtitle: From {{sender}} ({{account}}) · {{file}}
progress.keepOpen: You can keep using your computer. Postloom keeps sending in the background.
progress.stopBody: Postloom stops after the email going out now. You can carry on with the rest later.

paused.user: Paused. Nothing more is sent until you carry on.
paused.dailyLimit: Paused: this account has reached its daily limit. Carry on tomorrow, or raise the limit in Senders & accounts.
paused.auth: Paused: your email provider stopped accepting the password. Update it in Senders & accounts, then carry on.
paused.connection: Paused: Postloom couldn't reach your email provider. Check your internet connection, then carry on.
paused.interrupted: Postloom closed while sending. Check the emails below that may or may not have gone out, then carry on.
paused.sleep: Paused while the computer was asleep. Sending carries on when it wakes up.

progress.stopped: Stopped. {{count}} person hasn't been emailed yet.
progress.stopped_other: Stopped. {{count}} people haven't been emailed yet.
progress.doneFailed: {{count}} couldn't be sent. See why below.
progress.uncertainTitle: {{count}} email may or may not have been sent
progress.uncertainTitle_other: {{count}} emails may or may not have been sent
progress.uncertainBody: The connection dropped while they were going out, so Postloom can't tell. Sending again might give someone the same email twice.

reasons.rejected: Their email provider refused it (the address may not exist).
reasons.temporary: Their email provider kept saying “try later”.
reasons.invalid: The email couldn't be made (a line break in an address?).
reasons.template: The email couldn't be made from the template.
reasons.uncertain: May or may not have been sent (the connection dropped).
reasons.uncertainSkipped: Skipped: may or may not have been sent.
reasons.duplicate: The same address as an earlier row.
reasons.attachmentMissing: A file to attach had gone by the time it was sent.
reasons.attachmentBlocked: A file to attach was a private file (a key or password file).
reasons.attachmentTooBig: The attachments were too big for one email.

history.title: History
history.intro: Every send, with who got an email and who didn't.
history.emptyBody: When you send emails, each send is kept here with a report of who got one.
